Troubleshooting and Escalation: Follow predefined scripts and troubleshooting protocols to resolve issues and escalate complex incidents to IT Level 2 or Level 3 support teams when necessary. End-User Support: Provide effective, one-on-one support to end-users, both over the phone and in person, ensuring clear communication and customer satisfaction. System Monitoring: Regularly monitor IT systems and network performance, identifying potential issues before they impact end-users. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years. Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we're building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on. If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place. jobs.title: R&D Technician & Lab Manager
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Therapy Development Specialist serves as a strategic partner to both internal and external stakeholders by helping to advance clinical and operational initiatives within targeted health systems. This role is focused on account engagement, education, and program development, and is not intended to function as a routine procedural support or case coverage role. To meet the needs of our clients and those of our internal team, we will prioritize TDS candidates who currently reside in the NE Region (ME, MA, NY, NJ, CT, PA, VT). Specific Duties and Responsibilities • Act as a regional VTE care path expert, driving improved care path knowledge across the regional teams you support while supporting a broad coalition of customers. These may include treating and managing physicians, administration, staff, and other personnel to drive VTE program optimization by acting as a liaison between Penumbra (PEN) and all key stakeholders. Wir revolutionieren Ticketing für internationale Größen wie die Grammys, die Golden Globes, die Stanford University und den Hockenheimring – und machen aus einer einfachen Ticketing-Transaktion einen echten strategischen Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit über 65 Millionen US-Dollar an Finanzierung im Rücken ermöglicht unsere Plattform Veranstaltern, ihre Markenpräsenz selbst zu steuern, tiefgreifende Datenanalysen zu nutzen und Ticketing nahtlos in ihre digitale Infrastruktur zu integrieren. Mit sechs Standorten weltweit bieten wir eine intuitive, individuell anpassbare Lösung und branchenführenden Support, der selbst die komplexesten Herausforderungen im Ticketing vereinfacht. So helfen wir Veranstaltern, außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse zu schaffen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu erzielen. Werde Teil unserer Mission – und gestalte die Zukunft von Live-Entertainment mit.

The role bridges aircraft prototyping, hardware integration, HIL/ground testing, aircraft maintenance, and field flight operations, working closely with hardware, software, autonomy, and flight-test teams. The technician will build and modify prototype aircraft, integrate avionics and electrical systems, fabricate parts using 3D printing and other rapid-prototyping methods, and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, communications, and system-level issues. They will also build, maintain, and troubleshoot HIL rigs and related test infrastructure, help establish and maintain a local prototyping and flight-operations lab, and support aircraft readiness and field testing. This role is best suited for a versatile, self-sufficient senior technician who can move seamlessly between the lab, aircraft, HIL environment, and flight-test site—rapidly solving problems and helping engineering teams get systems ready for test and flight. Flight Ops Technician III.

Digitale Geschäftsprozesse verbinden bei uns alle Bereiche: vom Vertrieb über die Steuerung der Stoffströme und die Produktion bis zur kaufmännischen Abwicklung. Diese vernetzte Systemlandschaft wollen wir gezielt weiterentwickeln. jobs.title: Senior Associate (European Competition practice)
jobs.description_text:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analyses that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

CRA's European Competition practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation.  We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings:  firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid.  We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation effects of damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.  

For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit our website.

Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij? jobs.description_text: We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar. You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source.
